title: 18-Wheeler Full of Brisket Goes Up in Flames on I-35 in Texas - NewsBreak
text:
By Eric Ryan ,
5 hours ago
My goodness! I’m clutching my pearls over here. Partially because I’m hoping the driver got out of the truck before sustaining any injuries, but mostly because the thought of all that beautiful brisket burning to a crisp.
Drivers on Interstate 35 in Texas probably didn’t expect their commute to smell like a giant barbecue pit. But, as you can see in the video at the bottom of this article, an 18-wheeler hauling a full load of brisket went up in flames.
X/TikTok Brisket Means A Lot to Texans In Texas, brisket isn’t just food. It’s part of the culture. Barbecue restaurants take pride in slow-smoking it for hours until it’s tender and flavorful. That’s why this accident stood out so much. People in other states are probably laughing at the irony: one of Texas’s most iconic dishes literally went up in smoke on a Texas highway.

Cleanup crews spent several hours removing debris and ensuring the roadway was safe before reopening traffic. While the cause remains under investigation, the charred remains of the truck and its cargo became a brief but memorable roadside spectacle for those passing through.
On a personal note, it’s a good thing I wasn’t there to witness this catastrophe in person because I don’t think I could live with the visions haunting me at night.

These Texas Pups Are Waiting For You To Save Them Gallery Credit: Chaz All Kind Animal Initiative Dexie Dexie is a gentle soul with a shy side, but she warms up quickly with a little love. She’s great with other dogs and would thrive in a calm, patient home. Sweet and sensitive, Dexie is ready to blossom by your side. All Kind Animal Initiative Ana Meet Ana! Ana is a high-energy sweetheart who’s always ready for action! She loves to run, play, and burn off her zoomies with her dog friends—she gets along great with other pups. Ana thrives in an active home where she can stay busy and engaged. One thing to know: she’s not a fan of chickens, so a chicken-free household is a must. If you’re looking for a fun, energetic companion who’s full of love and always ready to go, Ana is your girl! All Kind Animal Initiative Ralphie Meet Ralphie! This mellow guy is all about the easy life—lounging, gentle strolls, and good company. He might be blind in one eye, but it doesn’t slow down his sweet soul. Ralphie gets along well with other dogs and brings a chill vibe wherever he goes. He is a total sweetheart that is full of love! All Kind Animal Initiative Chiquita Chiquita is a scruffy little terrier mix with a gentle heart. She was very scared when she first arrived at the shelter, but with time and patience, she’s grown into a sweet, affectionate companion. She still has moments of shyness and would do best in a calm home without children under 8. Once she feels safe, Chiquita loves to cuddle and has even started to play with other dogs. All Kind Animal Initiative Grover Grover is a handsome shepherd mix with a big heart and a sensitive nature. While he can be very sweet once he feels safe, Grover struggles with nervousness and can be a bit unpredictable at times. He tends to get a little nervous when being leashed and will need some time to work on leash training. He’s looking for a calm, adult-only home with someone patient and experienced—someone who understands that trust takes time. All Kind Animal Initiative Korbin Korbin is a handsome gray and white pup with a sharp mind and a strong personality. He’s looking for an experienced, adult-only home where he can thrive with structure, patience, and understanding. While Korbin can be affectionate and loyal with his people, he does best in a calm environment without children. He needs someone who respects his boundaries and is willing to work with him at his pace. All Kind Animal Initiative Chapel Chapel is a lovable pup with a gentle heart and a sweet nature. He’s been waiting patiently for a home to call his own, and he’s more than ready to find someone who will give him the love and security he deserves. Chapel gets along well with female dogs but does not do well with males, so he’ll need a home where any other dog companions are female—or where he can be your one and only. He’s affectionate, loyal, and just wants to be close to someone who cares. All Kind Animal Initiative Gigi Gigi is a gentle and sweet Shepherd mix with a loving heart and a calm spirit. She gets along well with other dogs and is ready to find her forever home where she can truly shine. Thanks to the generosity of Keith & Lorfing law firm, Gigi’s adoption fees are fully sponsored—making it even easier to welcome this wonderful girl into your life. Come meet Gigi and see just how special she is!
